rules.title: Jersey City Rent Control Ordinance (Chapter 260)
rules.requirement: Jersey City regulates rents through its Rent Control Ordinance, Chapter 260 of the Municipal Code. The Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations administers and enforces it, and a Rent Leveling Board and tenant illegal-rent petitions are part of the scheme. Properties with 1-4 units are exempt, and owners may request other exemptions. The passages do not state the cap or formula.

unverifiable_exemptions: Other exemptions under the ordinance that require a Rent Control Exemption Request reviewed by the Office
coverage.summary: Buildings with 5 or more units are covered. All 1-4 unit properties are exempt. Other exemptions exist but are not detailed in the passages.

rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt. Owners may submit a Rent Control Exemption Request for other permitted exemptions, which the passages do not detail.
rules.quoted_span: All 1-4 Unit Properties are exempt from rent control
rules.review_note: The passages give no rent increase cap, formula, or effective date. The record rests on a city webpage that references Chapter 260 and states the 1-4 unit exemption.
rules.source_notes: Official city Office of Landlord/Tenant Relations webpage, a secondary description of the ordinance.
